name: December
objective: Renew on personal usage data, pre-sell January, and turn Christmas gifting into new clients.
strategy:
Wrapped.

Commercial job: Renew on personal usage data, pre-sell January, and turn Christmas gifting into new clients.

Renewal: Wrapped: Your Top Artist Was Your Trainer (“Your top artist this year? Your trainer.”). A usage-based recommendation renews members onto plans that fit; year-in-review pages get shared.

Renewal: 12 Days of Shakemas (“Twelve days, twelve published deals. Day 12 is the big one.”). Published, rotating deals create daily traffic; the best prices sit on the longest plans and bulk privates (the allowed 25% cases).

Newcomer: Resolution Pre-Order (Ships 1 Jan) (“Your resolution, pre-ordered. Ships 1 January.”). December is softer than January in Mumbai; pre-selling lands buyers ready for Stronger in 30 2028.

Newcomer: Secret Santa Squats (“Secret Santa budget ₹2,000? Gift squats.”). Secret Santa budgets cluster at ₹1–2k; a voucher at that price reaches new people through colleagues. Effective 20% on conversion.

Lapsed: Last Seen: 2026 (We Noticed) (“Last seen: 2026. We noticed.”). Long-lapsed clients need a fresh start, not a bigger discount; the challenge gives a dated goal.
notes: Build: 75 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹8.4L; 82 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹19.2L; 37 winbacks = ₹4.2L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.1L. Offers carry ₹27.3L (78% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps
